issues.text_snippet: Email shall suffice as notice notwithstanding any failure of the intended recipient to receive such email.
issues.suggested_fix: Notice by email is effective only if the sender does not receive an automated delivery-failure notification. If delivery fails, the sender must give notice using another permitted method.

questions: Policy conflict: Notices and domicile has privacy-policy text in ideal and acceptable, while review_instruction addresses notice delivery. What notice terms were intended for those fields?
